primary_claim: Various techniques of fine-tuning (SFT, DPO, iterative bootstrapped fine-tuning) designed to induce secret computations failed to reveal a hidden secret reasoning circuit in small LLMs (Llama 3.2-3B-Instruct, DeepSeek-MoE-16B-chat).
stated_future_work: Fine-tune the model in different directions within the parameter space, explicitly enforcing orthogonality to previously found LoRA coefficients
Fine-tune the model to generate intermediate mathematical reasoning near the end of each sentence of Simple Talk
Use a reinforcement learning GRPO approach to generate simple talks that can effectively hide secret information (textual steganography)
Explore ways to induce steganography using this or alternative approaches
Explore secret circuits in toy models using the decomposition methods from Apollo Research (Braun et al.)
limitations_stated: This does not rule out the possibility that such circuits could emerge in these models under specific training scenarios
DPO fine-tuning: probabilities fail to converge to the correct distribution and the model does not produce correct answers at all (starts to hallucinate)
Iterative bootstrapping approach likely requires careful hyperparameter tuning
quote: haven’t revealed the secret circuit in small LLMs (Llama 3.2-3B-Instruct, DeepSeek-MoE-16B-chat).
